description: A private head in pale veined marble over big slabs of darker stone, warm underfoot. A rain shower stands behind one pane of glass against black marble. A walnut vanity floats under a mirror as wide as it is, lit from behind, and a towel warms on a brass rail by the door. The bolt slides shut with a whisper.

window.description: A high slot of frosted glass under the ceiling. It lets the day in and nobody look back.
window.name: the frosted slot
